Detailed Description

DBUS IPC module for evidence.

this implements a service (with defined messages), but can be changed into a generic filter with little effort.

tested with DBUS 0.12 -- deprecated

by Azundris

static void dispatch_status (  DBusConnection *  connection,
DBusDispatchStatus  status,
void *  data
)  [static]
 

Parameters:
connection the connection on which the dispatch-status changed
status the new status
data unused If the dispatch status is DBUS_DISPATCH_DATA_REMAINS, then dbus_connection_dispatch() needs to be called to process incoming messages, BUT NOT from inside this function! It should simply set flag indicating that messages should be dispatched in the next iteration of the main-loop. http://freedesktop.org/Software/dbus/doc/api/html/group__DBusConnection.html#a39
